feeds.title: Antitrust & Competition Policy Blog
feeds.description: Get information concerning antitrust & competition at Law Professor Blogs Network. It is the nation's only network of legal blogs edited primarily by law professors. Editors include leading scholars and educators who are committed to providing the web source of legal news, information, commentary, and analysis for law professors, practitioners, government and nonprofit lawyers, and students in their respective fields.

feeds.title: Kluwer Competition Law Blog
feeds.description: Kluwer Competition Law Blog is a publication of Kluwer Law International, providing information and news on international competition and antitrust law. As a global leader in expert solutions, we help professionals deliver deep impact when it matters most in the health, tax, accounting, finance, and legal sectors.

feeds.title: Antitrust Law Blog
feeds.description: Antitrust Law Blog by Sheppard Mullin covers Current Antitrust & Competition News & Regulatory Developments. We are a global law firm with over 1000 attorneys. We share real-time data, analytics, and predictive models with you in practical and intelligent ways to complement legal capabilities.

feeds.title: The Antitrust Attorney Blog
feeds.description: The Antitrust Attorney Blog was published by a California Antitrust Lawyer. Hi, my name is Jarod Bona, the person behind this blog page. It is primarily about antitrust and competition law, though I will periodically discuss issues relating to other areas, including appeals and my experience moving from big law to my own practice.

feeds.title: The Antitrust and Competition Law Blog
feeds.description: The Antitrust and Competition Law Blog is an initiative of Advocate Man Mohan Sharma. He started the Competition Lawyer website to write on Antitrust and competition issues. His articles are published in noted journals and financial newspapers, he also appears in TV interviews as a subject expert.

feeds.title: Patterson Belknap » Antitrust Update
feeds.description: Antitrust Update Blog is a source of insights, information, and analysis on criminal and civil antitrust and competition-related issues including the legal developments, trends, and changing regulations that impact businesses. Our antitrust lawyers represent clients in antitrust litigation and counseling matters related to pricing, marketing, distribution, and other strategic alliances.

feeds.title: Chillin'Competition
feeds.description: View the blog for all the announcements and information on Competition Law from Chillin'Competition. Alfonso Lamadrid and Pablo Ibáñez Colomo are the founders of Chillin Competition. They have started this website to communicate their expert reports, book reviews, research activities on competition law, and more.

feeds.title: Law360 » Competition
feeds.description: Competition Law360 covers breaking news in antitrust and competition law, corruption, litigation, lawsuits, and enforcement. This will be your one-stop source for legal news and analysis, providing up-to-the-minute coverage on the issues that affect attorneys, business leaders, and regulators.

feeds.title: The Contingency
feeds.description: The Contingency was published by Barry Barnett, a fellow of the American College of Trial Lawyers. Barnett provides expert and nuanced insight on complex matters, particularly ones involving antitrust, energy, or intellectual property in this legal blog.

feeds.title: Antitrust Alert
feeds.description: Antitrust Alert is a Global resource for compliance officers & Legal Advisors that offers updates on international compliance law. The firm helps propel today's most respected, dynamic & important organizations with a number of lawyers who have significant experience across a full range of antitrust issues.

feeds.title: Canadian Competition Law Blog
feeds.description: We are a Toronto based competition, advertising and regulatory law firm that blogs on competition, advertising and regulatory law and interesting business, white-collar crime and Internet and new media law and policy developments. We offer business, association, government and other clients in Toronto, Canada and internationally efficient and strategic advice in relation to Canadian competition, advertising, regulatory and new media laws.

feeds.title: African Antitrust & Competition Law
feeds.description: African Antitrust delivers up-to-date news & knowledge on competition law and related legal, business & economic developments.The firm serves a whole range of competition law and antitrust law services across the African continent

feeds.title: Antitrustpolitics.com
feeds.description: Discover articles related to the intersection of antitrust, foreign investment control, politics, and everything in between on Antitrustpolitics. The website is run by Tobias Pukropski, Paul Droessler, and Timo Angerbauer. They are all lawyers focused on European/German antitrust/competition law and foreign investment control.

feeds.title: Open Legal Blog Archive » Antitrust & Trade Regulation
feeds.description: In the following section of the Open Legal Blog Archive read articles and blog posts on Antitrust & Trade Regulation. Open Legal Blog Archive is a centralized database of all credible legal blog posts, worldwide, authors, and metadata, that is accessible via the web, RSS, and an API.

feeds.title: American Antitrust Institute
feeds.description: American Antitrust Institute is an independent, nonprofit organization devoted to promoting competition that protects consumers, businesses, and society. We serve the public through research, education, and advocacy on the benefits of competition and the use of antitrust enforcement as a vital component of national and international competition policy.

feeds.title: Cleary Antitrust Watch
feeds.description: Cleary's antitrust group offers a unique transatlantic perspective in today's increasingly borderless business landscape. The group is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession, working to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international.

feeds.title: Minding Your Business » Antitrust
feeds.description: Read the Antitrust blog featured on Minding Your Business, we also cover a variety of topics such as alternative dispute resolution, e-discovery, and evidence. These posts are designed to inform and provide insightful analysis regarding leading developments and emerging trends in the field.

feeds.title: Antitrust Law Source
feeds.description: Antitrust Law Source provides timely updates on all issues and industries pertaining to antitrust disputes. It is designed for visitors to quickly and easily learn about developments in the growing antitrust arena. Our primary format will be podcasts, but will also include e-books and articles from time to time.

feeds.title: Competition Law
feeds.description: Competition Law is a legal blog by Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas dedicated to the topics of Indian business competition. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is India's leading law firm, that advises a large and diverse set of clients, including domestic and foreign commercial enterprises, financial institutions, private equity funds, and many more.

feeds.title: Doyle, Barlow & Mazard PLLC Blog
feeds.description: Antitrust Lawyer Blog published by Doyle, Barlow & Mazard. DBM provides counseling on antitrust, international trade, and hospitality matters. At DBM, our goal is to combine our big firm experience with one-on-one attorney-client relationships that are easier to develop and maintain in a small firm environment.

feeds.title: Steptoe » Antitrust & Competition
feeds.description: The Steptoe Antitrust Competition blog features in-depth analyses and commentary on current antitrust. Steptoe's Antitrust & Competition is an international law firm. The team delivers creative, innovative, and practical solutions across the whole spectrum of antitrust and competition law.

feeds.title: Orrick » Antitrust Watch
feeds.description: Orrick's Antitrust blog is a one-stop resource to help practitioners through the daily avalanche of news, and also to provide in-depth analysis and commentary on major developments in antitrust and competition law. Orrick is a global law firm focused on serving the tech & innovation, energy & infrastructure, and Finance sectors globally.
